questions.question: When was warfarin started and what was the initially prescribed dose and INR target?
What is the documented reason for the change from warfarin 5 mg to 3 mg, and was it confirmed with an INR result?
What INR values have been recorded since warfarin started, and what was the most recent result?
Is there any bleeding or adverse effect recorded that prompted dose adjustment of warfarin?
What allergies or reactions to warfarin or other anticoagulants are recorded earlier in the record?
Were any follow-up tests or anticoagulation clinic reviews arranged after the dose change, and are they outstanding?
